title: Viking lander life tests read as finding life

tellings.quote: And they got mixed results which now can be interpreted as they they found life

plain: In 1976 the Viking landers, NASA spacecraft that set down on Mars, ran experiments meant to detect life in the soil and got mixed results, which a researcher named John Brandenburg says can now be read as having found life. Brandenburg gives this as his own interpretation, without naming a source. If he is right, life on Mars would have been detected nearly fifty years ago.
